Centec Communications.why: Fabless designer of Ethernet switch chips sold into domestic network-equipment makers' supply chains; its 12.8T / 25.6T flagship chips (up to 800G ports) target large-scale data-center and cloud networks, so data-center switch build-out drives its sales.
Centec Communications.evidence: Centec Communications half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026): its 12.8Tbps and 25.6Tbps high-end flagship chips for large-scale data-center and cloud-service needs, with a maximum port rate of 800G, have entered the application stage at customers; its self-developed Ethernet switch chips have entered the supply chains of H3C, Ruijie Networks, Maipu Technology and other domestic mainstream network-equipment makers.

players.product: Ethernet switch chips: 12.8T / 25.6T flagship chips (up to 800G ports) for large-scale data centers and cloud, TsingMa.MX 2.4T and GoldenGate 1.2T series, plus switch-chip modules and Ethernet switches

quarterly_data.quarter: Centec Communications half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (half-year report): revenue RMB 670,682,360.50, up 32.04% from RMB 507,954,007.61; net loss attributable to shareholders RMB -17,566,204.04 (H1 2025: RMB -23,689,074.15), the loss narrowing 25.85%; net loss after non-recurring items RMB -36,224,500.11 (H1 2025: RMB -62,815,284.69), the loss narrowing 42.33%. Company: revenue grew mainly as it pushed the introduction of high-end chip products and accelerated their commercial deployment, while derivative / iterated products were gradually introduced to the market. Operating cash flow was RMB -327,250,128.27 (H1 2025: RMB 138,784,495.54) because the company raised its stock levels in line with the market trend.

quarterly_data.quarter: Centec Communications half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: the company's 12.8Tbps and 25.6Tbps high-end flagship Ethernet switch chips for large-scale data-center and cloud-service needs, with a maximum port rate of 800G, have entered the application stage at customers, with switching capacity and port rate at the level of international competing products (company's claim); among products in volume production, TsingMa.MX offers 2.4Tbps forwarding. (The 2025 annual report had said the flagship chips' performance 'will reach' the international level.) The product range covers 100Gbps-25.6Tbps switching capacity and 100M-800G port rates.

quarterly_data.quarter: Centec Communications half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report R&D: H1 2026 R&D expense RMB 26,147.94 ten-thousand, up 9.29%, 38.99% of revenue (H1 2025: 47.10%); 412 R&D staff. New project: an intelligent-computing (AI cluster) switch chip project with planned total investment of RMB 65,000.00 ten-thousand (RMB 34.15 ten-thousand spent so far), still in R&D, aiming to support mainstream intelligent-computing interconnect protocols, low-latency forwarding and point-to-point reliability for high-performance networking in intelligent-computing applications. The high-performance core switch chip project (planned RMB 183,000.00 ten-thousand; RMB 151,759.67 ten-thousand spent cumulatively) continues, targeting up to 800G ports for large-scale and industry data centers. The IPO-funded router-switch converged network chip R&D project is due to reach its intended state in November 2026.

quarterly_data.quarter: Centec Communications half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report, supply: prepayments rose to RMB 298,546,782.12 (up 37.39% from year-end) mainly because the company increased its capacity reservations with suppliers; inventory rose to RMB 552,117,831.30 (up 47.39%; RMB 55,211.78 ten-thousand, 22.07% of total assets) as the company raised stock levels, which it attributes to larger sales, rising product demand and greater uncertainty of upstream capacity supply under the global semiconductor supply situation. The company is fabless and mostly works through chip mass-production agents that deal with the wafer fabs and packaging-test houses, so supplier concentration is high; qualified foundry and packaging-test suppliers are few. The company and its subsidiary Centec Technology have been on the US Entity List since March 3, 2023, which restricts purchases of controlled items with a high share of US technology.

quarterly_data.quarter: Centec Communications half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report, company plan: the company will actively push application points for its high-end flagship chips aimed at large-scale data centers and cloud services, strengthen in-depth collaboration with leading domestic cloud service providers and data-center operators, and advance product scenario adaptation, test validation and scaled deployment; it will keep a high level of R&D spending and diversify supply sources to secure stable supply.

quarterly_data.quarter: Centec Communications half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customers H3C, Ruijie Networks, Maipu Technology (half-year report): the company's self-developed Ethernet switch chips have entered the supply chains of domestic mainstream network-equipment makers such as H3C, Ruijie Networks and Maipu Technology; Ethernet switching equipment built around its chips is deployed at scale by major domestic carriers and in finance, government, transport and energy networks.
